Haitian Boy Detained by ICE Released in San Diego

An 8-year-old Haitian boy detained by U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) in San Diego has been released from custody and reunited with his family. Advocates stated the boy was taken into ICE custody during a check-in. He has since returned home.
